scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Greetings, adventurer.
I am Gatei Knumm, keeper
of this Thanatos Tower.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
冒險者，您好。
我是加泰·克努姆，這座達納托斯塔的守塔人。
請問有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation: 達納托斯塔？

scripts.text: Entrance Fee?
scripts.translation: 入場費？

scripts.text: Enter the tower
scripts.translation: 進入塔內

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Yes, the tower in front
of you was an ancient ruins
that got its name from a word
written on a stone plate found
inside. Today, this place is
a popular tourist attraction.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
是的，您面前的這座塔原本是古代遺蹟，
其名稱來源於在塔內發現的一塊石板上的文字。
如今，這裡已成為一處熱門的旅遊景點。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
This tower grew in popularity
for adventurers when the
Rekenber Corporation began
tower reconstruction efforts.
The 1st and 2nd floors are now
repaired and free of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
當雷肯貝爾公司開始進行塔體修復工程後，
這座塔在冒險者中逐漸變得流行起來。
目前，1樓和2樓已經修復完畢，且沒有魔物出沒。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
However, reconstruction of
the 3rd and higher floors is
incomplete. Those levels are
still infested with monsters, so we're contracting temp workers
to exterminate all of them.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
不過，3樓及更高層的修復工作尚未完成。
那些樓層仍然有魔物出沒，因此我們正招募臨時工
來清除所有的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
If you're interested in
temporary contract work,
or would like to know about
this place in detail, please
ask one of the guides inside.
Thank you and enjoy your visit~
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
如果您對臨時契約工作感興趣，
或者想詳細瞭解這個地方，
請諮詢塔內的嚮導。
謝謝，祝您參觀愉快~

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Everyone is welcome to
enjoy Thanatos Tower.
Only the 1st and 2nd floors
are open to the public at
this time. The entrance fee
is 5,000 zeny per person.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
歡迎所有人來達納托斯塔遊玩。
目前僅1樓和2樓對公眾開放。
入場費為每人5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
5,000 zeny may seem a little
steep for a tourist attraction,
but trust me, this tower provides a very unique experience. Also,
our loyal customers and contract workers get a special discount~
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
5,000 Zeny作為旅遊景點的門票可能略顯昂貴，
但請相信我，這座塔能帶來非常獨特的體驗。
此外，
我們的忠實顧客和契約工人可以享受特別折扣~

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Would you like to
enter Thanatos Tower?
The entry fee is ^FF00005,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
您想要進入達納托斯塔嗎？
入場費為^FF00005,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Oh, {0}!
Welcome back! Since you've
got a temporary Rekenber
work contract, your entrance
fee is only 3,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
哦，{0}！
歡迎回來！既然您持有雷肯貝爾的臨時工作契約，
您的入場費只需3,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Thank you, and
please keep up the
good work. Ah, and don't
forget: safety first when
you fight those monsters!
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
謝謝，
請繼續努力工作。啊，還有別忘了：
與魔物戰鬥時，安全第一！

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Oh, I'm sorry...
But you don't seem to
have enough zeny. Oh well,
just come back again later~
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
哦，抱歉...
看來您的Zeny不足。好吧，
請稍後再來~

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
You must be busy, then.
Well, not to worry, we'll
always be here. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
您一定很忙吧。
嗯，別擔心，我們會一直在這裡。再見~

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Ah, I've received your
entrance fee. Thank you
very much. Now, I hope
you enjoy your visit
to Thanatos Tower~
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
啊，我已收到您的入場費。
非常感謝。現在，
希望您能在達納托斯塔度過愉快的時光~

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Well...
Hm. I'm sorry, but you
don't seem to have enough
zeny for the entrance fee.
Please come back later...
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
嗯...
唔。抱歉，看來您的Zeny不足以支付入場費。
請稍後再來...

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Very well. Please come
and visit us again here
in Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
好的。歡迎再次光臨達納托斯塔。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Hmm? Very well.
But if you wish to visit
this Thanatos Tower, please
do not hesitate to ask me.
Thank you and have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
嗯？好的。
但如果您想參觀這座達納托斯塔，
請隨時向我諮詢。
謝謝，祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Tower Keeper]
Excuse me, but you cannot
enter. This place is under
the Rekenber Corporation's
administration, and this area
is restricted to all those
without authorization.
scripts.translation:
[守塔人]
抱歉，您不能進入。
此地由雷肯貝爾公司管理，
該區域禁止所有未經授權人員進入。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Welcome to Thanatos Tower.
The tower's reconstruction is
a Rekenber Corporation project,
and the 1st and 2nd floors are
now open to the public. So
how may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
歡迎來到達納托斯塔。
這座塔的改建工程是雷肯貝爾公司的專案，
目前1樓和2樓已向公眾開放。
請問今天有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Tower Information
scripts.translation: 塔樓資訊

scripts.text: Temporary Work Contract
scripts.translation: 臨時工作契約

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
When this tower was built,
who built it, and its purpose
are all mysteries. There are
many rumors about it being a
Mage lab, a hero's momunent,
or a demon fortress...
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
這座塔是何時建造的、由誰建造、
以及它的用途，至今仍是謎團。
關於它的傳說有很多，
有人說它是魔法師的實驗室，
也有人說它是英雄的紀念碑，
甚至是惡魔的堡壘...

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
The Rekenber Corporation has
been researching the origin of
this tower, but has not yet been able to confirm anything. Although
we've lost many researchers to the tower monsters, we won't give up!
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
雷肯貝爾公司一直在研究這座塔的起源，
但至今尚未確認任何事實。雖然
我們有許多研究員喪命於塔內的魔物，
但我們不會放棄！

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Rekenber is convinced that this
tower holds many secrets, and
successfully reconstructed the
first 2 floors of this tower in
the pursuit of this knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
雷肯貝爾堅信這座塔隱藏著許多秘密，
為了追尋這些知識，
我們成功改建了這座塔的前兩層。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Currently, we are focused on
reconstructing the tower's 3rd
and 4th floors. Luckily, many
adventurers are exterminating
the monsters on those floors, working under temporary contracts.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
目前，我們正專注於改建
這座塔的3樓和4樓。幸運的是，
許多冒險者正在那裡清剿魔物，
他們與我們簽訂了臨時工作契約。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
At this rate, we expect
to complete reconstruction
of the 3rd and 4th floors in
the near future, bringing us
closer to our goal of opening all 12 floors of Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
照這個進度，我們預計
在不久的將來完成3樓和4樓的改建，
這將讓我們更接近
開放達納托斯塔全部12層的目標。

scripts.text: Tower Monsters?
scripts.translation: 塔內的魔物？

scripts.text: Temp Contract Work?
scripts.translation: 臨時工作契約？

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Yes, when we began
reconstruction of the
Thanatos Tower, these
monsters that look like angels
just appeared out of nowhere
to attack all the workers.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
是的，當我們開始
改建達納托斯塔時，
這些看起來像天使的魔物
不知從哪裡冒出來，
攻擊了所有的工人。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
At first, witnesses thought
that these monsters might
be, you know, actual angels.
But if they were, why were they
attacking for no reason?
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
起初，目擊者以為
這些魔物可能是真正的天使。
但如果是天使，
為什麼要無緣無故地攻擊呢？

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Anyway, we asked the Juno 
Sage Academy to investigate
them, and they confirmed that
these angelic creatures are true monsters--their resemblance to
angels is merely coincidence.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
總之，我們請朱諾賢者學院
進行了調查，他們確認
這些天使般的生物確實是魔物——
它們長得像天使只是巧合。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
You may have already heard
from the Tower Keeper, but
we're contracting adventurers to exterminate the tower monsters
in the 3rd and higher levels on
a temporary employee basis.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
您可能已經從守塔人那裡聽說了，
我們正在招募冒險者，
以臨時員工的身份
清剿3樓及以上樓層的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
I'm in charge of hiring
temp contract workers, so
talk to me if you're interested. Only temp workers are allowed
to access the higher levels
here in Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
我負責招募臨時契約工，
如果您有興趣，請與我交談。
只有臨時工才允許
進入達納托斯塔的高層。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
To develop the floors above
the 2nd floor, we're going to
need as many temp contract
workers as we can hire. Why
don't you consider working
for us under a temp contract?
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
為了開發2樓以上的樓層，
我們需要儘可能多的臨時契約工。
您何不考慮與我們簽訂
臨時工作契約呢？

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
You may have already heard
from the Tower Keeper, but
we're contracting adventurers to exterminate the tower monsters
in the 3rd and higher levels on
a temporary employee basis.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
您可能已經從守塔人那裡聽說了，
我們正在招募冒險者，
以臨時員工的身份
清剿3樓及以上樓層的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
I'm in charge of hiring
temp contract workers, so
talk to me if you're interested. Only temp workers are allowed
to access the higher levels
here in Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
我負責招募臨時契約工，
如果您有興趣，請與我交談。
只有臨時工才允許
進入達納托斯塔的高層。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Well, if you have any
questions, feel free to
ask me later. My name is
Ditze Lappa. Have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
嗯，如果您有任何問題，
稍後可以隨時問我。
我叫迪策·拉帕。祝您有美好的一天！

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
For more detailed information
about monster exterminations,
please ask the 2nd Floor Guide
and the Guide next to me. Well,
we hope you enjoy your experience working with Rekenber Corporation~
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
如需瞭解更多關於清剿魔物的詳細資訊，
請諮詢2樓的嚮導
以及我旁邊的嚮導。嗯，
希望您能與雷肯貝爾公司合作愉快~

scripts.text: Maybe next time
scripts.translation: 下次再說吧

scripts.text: Sure, I'd like to work for you.
scripts.translation: 好的，我想為你們工作。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Well, alright.
But come and talk to
me as soon as you decide
that you want to help with
the tower reconstruction by
working for Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
嗯，好的。
但請在我這裡決定
是否願意為雷肯貝爾工作，
協助塔樓改建時，
儘快來找我。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
That's great!
Would you please fill
out this employment
agreement first? Let's
see. Your name is...
{0}, right?
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
太好了！
請先填寫這份
僱傭協議好嗎？
讓我看看。您的名字是...
{0}，對吧？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Alright, please read
this agreement carefully.
If you agree with all of
the conditions, go ahead
and just sign the bottom.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
好的，請仔細閱讀
這份協議。
如果您同意所有條款，
請在底部簽字即可。

scripts.text:
^3355FFDitze hands you the
Employment Agreement
document for you to read.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF迪策遞給您
一份僱傭協議
供您閱讀。^000000

scripts.text:

is effective between Rekenber

Employer Signature____________

Sign
scripts.translation: 簽字

scripts.text: Don't Sign
scripts.translation: 不簽字

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou sign two copies of the
Employment Agreement.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您簽署了
兩份僱傭協議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Thank you. Now, you are
an official employee of the
Rekenber Corporation! Well,
within the limits of this tower
anyway. This contract doesn't
apply outside of this place.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
謝謝。現在，您已經是
雷肯貝爾公司的正式員工了！
當然，是在這座塔的範圍內。
這份合同在此地之外不適用。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
From now on, you can talk
to the 2nd Floor Guide to
enter the 3rd Floor. If you
have any mission reward
questions, please ask ^3355FFLiei^000000.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
從現在開始，您可以與
2樓的嚮導交談
以進入3樓。如果您有任何
任務獎勵的問題，請諮詢^3355FF莉埃^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
If you want to check
more information about
your work, please talk
to the 2nd Floor Guide.
Thank you, and welcome
to the Rekenber Corporation~
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
如果您想檢視
更多工作資訊，請與
2樓的嚮導交談。
謝謝，歡迎加入
雷肯貝爾公司~

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Oh? Was there an article
within the contract that you
disagreed with? Hm. Well,
that's fine. But if you change
your mind, please come back
and ask me anytime. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
哦？合同中是否有
您不同意的條款？嗯。
沒關係。但如果您改變主意，
請隨時回來找我。謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Good day, I'm
Liei Kuniziet of the
Employee Mission
Reward Department
here in Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
您好，我是
達納托斯塔
員工任務獎勵部門的
莉埃·庫尼齊特。

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Ah, hello~
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
啊，你好~
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Employee's mission reward?
scripts.translation: 員工任務獎勵？

scripts.text: Keep up the good work.
scripts.translation: 繼續加油。

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Currently, Rekenber Corporation
is contracting temp employees
to develop the higher levels
of Thanatos Tower. If you'd
like to apply, please ask
Ditze right next to me.
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
目前，雷肯貝爾公司
正在招募臨時員工
開發達納托斯塔的高層。
如果您想申請，請詢問
我旁邊的迪策。

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Thank you. Ah, and I hope
that you enjoy your visit
here to Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
謝謝。啊，希望您
在達納托斯塔的訪問愉快。

scripts.text:
Ah, hello~
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
啊，你好~
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Reward
scripts.translation: 獎勵

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Alright, then.
Please do your best
to exterminate the
monsters that infest
the higher floors of
the Thanatos Tower~
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
好的。
請盡力清剿
達納托斯塔高層
滋生的魔物~

scripts.text:
[Liei]
You're {0}, yes?
Let me check our temp
employee records for--ah.
Here it is. Alright, so would
you please tell me what kind
of mission proof you brought?
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
您是{0}，對吧？
讓我查一下我們的臨時
員工記錄——啊。
在這裡。好的，那麼請告訴我
您帶來了哪種任務證明？

scripts.text: Golden Ornament
scripts.translation: 金色手鐲

scripts.text: Red Feather
scripts.translation: 紅色羽毛

scripts.text: Blue Feather
scripts.translation: 藍色羽毛

scripts.text: Cursed Seal
scripts.translation: 被詛咒的印

scripts.text:
[Liei]
I'm sorry, but you are not
carrying any {0}.
Please check your inventory
one more time, and then come
to me to redeem your items
for a reward later, alright?
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
很抱歉，您身上並沒有攜帶{0}。
請再次檢查您的物品欄，
之後再來找我兌換獎勵，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Liei]
The reward for each
{0} is...
 
1,000 zeny
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
每個{0}的獎勵是...

1,000 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Liei]
{0}, then
you will receive a total of...
 
{1} zeny
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
那麼，{0}
您總共將獲得...

{1} Zeny

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Would you like to exchange
all of your {0}
for your reward right now?
Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Great! Here is your
{0} zeny. Thank you,
and please keep up
the good work~
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
太好了！這是您的
{0} Zeny。謝謝，
請繼續努力工作~

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Sure, no problem.
Just come back and
talk to me whenever
you want to receive
your reward, alright?
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
當然，沒問題。
想領取獎勵的時候
隨時回來找我對話就好，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
You are in front of the entrance to the 3rd Floor. Only contracted
temp employees are authorized
to enter that area. For Rekenber temp contract information, please
speak to the 2nd Floor Guide.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
您正站在3樓的入口處。只有簽訂了
合同的臨時員工才有許可權進入該區域。如需瞭解雷肯貝爾的臨時合同資訊，請
與2樓的嚮導對話。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
This is the path to the 3rd floor.
Only the contracted staff are allowed to enter.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
這是通往3樓的通道。
只有簽約的職員才能進入。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Let me go to 3rd floor.
scripts.translation: 讓我去3樓

scripts.text: Tower Information.
scripts.translation: 中央塔資訊

scripts.text: Start a conversation.
scripts.translation: 開始對話

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Oh, alright. Let me
check and see if you're
on our temp list. Hmmm...
Ah, you're {0}, right?
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
哦，好的。讓我
查一下您是否在
我們的臨時員工名單上。嗯...
啊，您是{0}，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
First, we need to wait until
at least 5 temps are gathered
to form a work group. Right
now, there are a total of
{0} temp workers waiting to
enter the 3rd Floor.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
首先，我們需要等待
至少5名臨時員工聚集
以組成工作小組。目前，共有
{0}名臨時工人在等待
進入3樓。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Great, you're just
in time. We just met
the minimum 5 temp group
requirement, so we'll open
the gate to the 3rd Floor soon.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
太好了，您來得
正是時候。我們剛剛達到
5人臨時小組的最低要求，
所以我們將很快開啟
通往3樓的大門。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
If you can, try to get
your friends to help you
by coming near me. Please
understand that we have this
temp worker group requirement
for various safety reasons.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
如果可以的話，請讓您的
朋友過來協助您，
靠近我這邊。請理解我們
有這項臨時工人小組要求
是出於各種安全原因。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The gate to the 3rd Floor
will close shortly, so enter it
as soon as you can. We have
to close it quickly because we
can't have the tower monsters
entering the lower floors...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
通往3樓的大門
即將關閉，請儘快進入。
我們必須迅速關閉它，因為
我們不能讓塔裡的魔物
進入低層...

scripts.text:
^4d4dffBurled is smiling lightly so that only I notice.
I nod, then watch him open the gate.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff伯爾德微微一笑，只有我察覺到了。
我點了點頭，看著他打開了大門。^000000

scripts.text:
[Burled]
This gate is the only passage
that connects to the 3rd Floor.
After the 4th Floor, passages
between floors only travel one
way, meaning you can't exit the
same way you that you entered.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
這扇門是通往3樓的唯一通道。
從4樓開始，樓層間的通道都是單向的，
也就是說，您無法從進入的通道原路返回。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
You see, there's a strange
power that affects the 5th
Floor, and all floors above,
which doesn't allow people to
backtrack through the passage in which they entered the floor.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
您看，5樓及以上的所有樓層都受到一種神秘力量的影響，
這種力量不允許人們通過進入該樓層的通道原路返回。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
So if you ascend past the
4th Floor, please be careful
and make sure that you find
a way to get back.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
所以，如果您要登上4樓以上，請務必小心，
並確保找到返回的方法。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The top is the 12th floor,
and the monsters grow more powerful
as you ascend the tower.
The geographical features also change considerably.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
塔頂是12樓，
隨著樓層升高，魔物會變得更加強大。
地形特徵也會發生顯著變化。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Because the higher levels are
too dangerous, we only open the
3rd Floor Gate when 5 or more
are gathered here. Therefore,
you may need to wait if less
than 5 temps have gathered.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
由於高層過於危險，
我們只會在聚集了5名或以上臨時工時才打開3樓的大門。
因此，如果臨時工不足5人，您可能需要等待。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...?
Do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
...？
您有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text: About the development.
scripts.translation: 關於開發情況

scripts.text: The relationship of Cool Event Corporation and Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation: 酷事件公司與雷肯貝爾公司的關係

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
請多保重。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...um, you're quite curious.
If you want to know more, would you do me a favor?
Since you asked for our confidential info...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
...嗯，您挺好奇的。
如果您想了解更多，能幫我個忙嗎？
既然您問了我們的機密資訊...

scripts.text: Really? Don't make me afraid of it.
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？別讓我害怕。

scripts.text: Just tell me about it.
scripts.translation: 直接告訴我吧。

scripts.text: I'll listen about it later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再聽。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
As you wish...
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
如你所願...
請多保重！

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Haha. That's not a big deal.
We, Cool Event, are the corporation that works in many areas of business.
From simple events, guides for dungeons, and trading items.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
哈哈，這沒什麼大不了的。
我們酷事件公司涉足許多商業領域。
從簡單的活動、地下城嚮導到物品交易。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Though our business started as a small one, we've been getting bigger with assistance from the Rekenber Corporation.
They suggested to develop this tower together.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
雖然我們的業務起初規模很小，但在雷肯貝爾公司的幫助下，我們不斷發展壯大。
他們建議共同開發這座塔。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The Rekenber Corporation is only digging out the remains for studies.
The rest would be made into sightseeing place, which Cool Event Corporation can manage well.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
雷肯貝爾公司只負責挖掘遺蹟進行研究。
其餘部分將改造成觀光景點，這正適合酷事件公司來管理。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
It's the biggest business ever.
Also quite profitable as tourist attractions.
But...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
這是有史以來最大的業務。
作為旅遊景點也相當有利可圖。
但是...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Considerably strong monsters spawn inside the tower.
The monsters weren't spawned there before.
The day after that happened...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
塔內會生成相當強大的魔物。
這些魔物之前並不存在。
就在那件事發生後的第二天...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...anyway, there were some accidently spawned monsters and some troubles...
We and the Rekenber Corporation are in shock.
We were influenced economically, but the more serious thing is...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
...總之，發生了一些意外，生成了魔物，還惹出了不少麻煩...
我們和雷肯貝爾公司都受到了衝擊。
雖然經濟上受到了影響，但更嚴重的是...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Many staff involved in development are
sacrificing themselves by coming to 3rd floor.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
許多參與開發的職員
為了探索第三層而犧牲了自己。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
While we've pumped our all into the business, that accident happened...
We eventually merged with the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
我們原本全心投入這項業務，卻發生了那場意外...
最終，我們不得不與雷肯貝爾公司合併。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The development is on hold temporarily.
Recruiting adventurers to defeat monsters...
Isn't this funny?
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
開發工作暫時擱置了。
招募冒險者去消滅魔物...
這難道不滑稽嗎？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
No matter what happened there, they wouldn't be hurt.
Even if they don't get at the root of the accident....
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
無論那裡發生了什麼，他們都不會受傷。
即使他們無法查明事故的根源...

scripts.text: Oh...
What accident are you referring to?
scripts.translation: 你指的是什麼事故？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Yes, it's not that big of a deal. Haha....
If we are working here like this....
we would know about the death of animals.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
是的，沒什麼大不了的。哈哈....
既然我們在這裡工作....
對於動物的死亡，我們也是有所瞭解的。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Cool Event Corporation is considered the follower...
They don't clear up how many people
died or any reasons for it.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
酷事件公司被視為信徒...
他們並沒有澄清有多少人
死亡，也沒有說明原因。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Now you're curious about this case.
What do they sacrifice for?
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
現在你對這個案子感到好奇了。
他們是為了什麼而犧牲？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
I talked a lot.
Sorry, I am not supposed to talk about this case like this...
I've been quite concerned about it, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
我說了太多。
抱歉，我不應該這樣談論這個案子...
我只是對此相當擔憂而已。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
If you promise me that
you will do me a favor...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
如果你答應我
會幫我一個忙...

scripts.text: Ok! I will.
scripts.translation: 好的！我會的。

scripts.text: No, I won't.
scripts.translation: 不，我不會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What's the accident...?
He might let me know later...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(那場事故是什麼...?
他之後可能會告訴我...)

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...there is no way...
They request you to explore the internal part.
You're employed for this exploration.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
...沒有別的辦法了...
他們要求你探索內部。
你被僱傭來進行這次探索。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Rekenber Corporation must have another intention,
since they don't seem interested in the tower much.
I want to know their intention.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
雷肯貝爾公司一定另有意圖，
因為他們似乎對這座塔並不太感興趣。
我想知道他們的意圖。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
This tower is sealed and separated from the outside.
We need to break those seals, explore inside and develop it.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
這座塔被封印，與外界隔絕。
我們需要打破那些封印，探索內部並進行開發。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
We are developing the 3rd and 4th floors now...
There are still seals there.
You can find out some clues when you search around them.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
我們正在開發第三層和第四層...
那裡仍然有封印。
當你在那裡搜尋時，可能會發現一些線索。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The magical key and messages?
...we absolutely haven't learned all the tower's secrets...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
魔法鑰匙和資訊？
...我們絕對還沒有掌握這座塔的所有秘密...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Who made the seals?
...can you investigate more?
There must be definitive evidence...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
是誰設下的封印？
...你能再深入調查一下嗎？
一定會有確鑿的證據...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Any new progress?
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
有什麼新的進展嗎？

scripts.text: I found Varmunt's Journal...
scripts.translation: 我找到了瓦爾蒙特的日記...

scripts.text:
- You show him Varmunt's Journal.
Burled reads it. -
scripts.translation:
- 你向伯爾德展示了瓦爾蒙特的日記。
伯爾德讀了起來。 -

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...I recognize this.
This is the hologragh of the wise man Varmunt.
Regenschirm from Rekenber's huge research institute has...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
...我認得這個。
這是智者瓦爾蒙特的全息影像。
雷根修蘆來自雷肯貝爾巨大的研究所...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...isn't this the one they are looking for now?!
Isn't their mission to find out Varmunt's research materials...?
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
...這不正是他們現在在尋找的東西嗎？！
他們的任務不就是找出瓦爾蒙特的研究資料嗎...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
For assisting uncompleted research...
Varmunt's research materials are needed...
...so their mission isn't just an investigation of the tower.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
為了協助未完成的研究...
需要瓦爾蒙特的研究資料...
...所以他們的任務不僅僅是調查這座塔。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Something to get as an advantage...
Even they don't know where it is...
...anyways, this is the one of their main objects.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
那是他們想要獲取的優勢...
即使他們自己也不知道它在哪裡...
...總之，這是他們的主要目標之一。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
It's absolutely great. The wise man Varmunt's belongings. How unbelievable!
Now, what do we do with this?
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
這太棒了。智者瓦爾蒙特的遺物。簡直難以置信！
現在，我們要怎麼處理這個？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Originally everything we found out in this tower was under control of the Rekenber Corporation.
This is supposed to theirs, but...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
原本我們在這座塔裡發現的一切，都受雷肯貝爾公司控制。
按理說這應該屬於他們，但是...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
How would you like to keep this, {0}?
Definitely this should be a secret.
...um, this is a little revenge for them.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
你想保留這個嗎，{0}？
這絕對應該是個秘密。
...嗯，這算是對他們的一點報復。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
I can guess that there are several secrets in this tower through this note.
This secret should be disclosed by you, {0}, before Rekenber does.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
通過這張紙條，我可以推測這座塔裡還有好幾個秘密。
這個秘密應該由你，{0}，在雷肯貝爾之前揭露出來。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
No matter how much power they obtain... they won't get to know about this tower...
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
無論他們獲得多大的權力...他們都不會知道這座塔的事...
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...haha...
I feel a bit relieved.
Thanks.
This isn't much, but here's a return present.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
...哈哈...
我感覺輕鬆了一些。
謝謝。
雖然不多，但這是給你的回禮。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
I hope that these will be useful for you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
希望這些對你有用，{0}。

scripts.text:
- Burled gives you the note and an Old Violet Box. -
 
^4d4dffYou acquire one Old Violet Box,
as well as a little EXP.^000000
scripts.translation:
- 伯爾德給了你那張紙條和一箇舊紫色盒子。 -
 
^4d4dff你獲得了1箇舊紫色盒子，
以及少量的經驗值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Are you keeping the secrets well?
Is there a Phantom on the top of this tower?
You look tired. This isn't a big deal, but it's for you.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
你守口如瓶嗎？
這座塔的頂端有幻影嗎？
你看起來很累。雖然不算什麼大事，但這是給你的。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Are you keeping the secrets well?
Is there a Phantom on the top of this tower?
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
你守口如瓶嗎？
這座塔的頂端有幻影嗎？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Ah, it's not that difficult.
After you explore the tower, let me know in detail anything you learn.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
啊，沒那麼難。
探索完塔之後，把你瞭解到的細節告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...I can't believe the Rekenber Corporation. Many colleagues and friends died for them.
But the Rekenber Corporation doesn't expose the reason they are dead.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
...我真不敢相信雷肯貝爾公司。許多同事和朋友為他們而死。
但雷肯貝爾公司卻不公開他們死亡的原因。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The conditions were bad for us from beginning...
All of the developed places except research materials would be turned into tourist attractions...
Honestly, all the personnel are from Cool Event Corp.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
從一開始，我們的處境就很糟糕...
除了研究材料，所有開發出來的地方都會變成旅遊景點...
說實話，所有的工作人員都來自酷事件公司。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
They know about it as well.
This business needs much sacrifice as well as personnel who are up for it.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
他們對此也心知肚明。
這項業務需要大量的犧牲，也需要願意為此付出的人員。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Now I don't feel victimized anymore, but I just want to know what drives these accidents...
^4d4dffWhat makes us victimized...?^000000
That's what I want to know.
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
現在我不再覺得自己是受害者了，但我只是想知道是什麼導致了這些事故...
^4d4dff是什麼讓我們成為了受害者...？^000000
這就是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
What's this tower?
Why did they develop this dangerous place?
And for what? Should my colleagues be dead for it?
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
這座塔是什麼？
他們為什麼要開發這個危險的地方？
又是為了什麼？難道我的同事們就該為此而死嗎？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
I seriously want to know about it.
Why they must sacrifice themselves...
Let me know...
scripts.translation:
[伯爾德]
我真的非常想知道真相。
為什麼他們必須犧牲自己...
請告訴我...

scripts.text:
He seriously wants to know about it.
His hands are trembling now...
I nodd without answering.
scripts.translation:
他真的很想知道真相。
他的手現在正在顫抖...
我點了點頭，沒有回答。

scripts.text:
^3355FFA mysterious field of
energy seems to surround
the mechanical device and
its power prevents you from
approaching the machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一股神秘的力量場
似乎環繞著這個機械裝置，
其力量阻止了你
靠近這臺機器。^000000

scripts.text: Investigate it.
scripts.translation: 調查一下

scripts.text: I don't care about it.
scripts.translation: 我不在乎它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This seems mysterious...
Let me investigate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這看起來很神秘...
讓我調查一下。

scripts.text: ^3355FFAs you follow the magical power, there's something wrapped inside the rune device.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF當你跟隨那股魔力時，發現符文裝置內部包裹著什麼東西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou kick the energy
field with all of your strength. After absorbing the impact, the
field fizzles out with a soft,
gentle ''pzzzzzh'' sound.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你用盡全力踢向能量場。在承受住衝擊後，
能量場發出一聲輕柔的“滋滋”聲，

^b22222I've used the Gate Seal

^b22222I can't relax when a, shall

the charm stones and can easily
break the seals. Since they are
broken now, are many people hurt?

^b22222This tower contains strong

dangerous by itself, but I sealed it
because of one man's strong desires...

^b22222Nobody believed me, the crazy scientist.

石像上的裝飾部件開始旋轉，
一道耀眼的光束沿著優雅的石像向上攀升。
一股強大的詛咒之力湧現，
散發出耀眼的綠光。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffAll of a sudden, the Green Key appears and you can feel great power from it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff突然，綠色鑰匙出現了，你能感受到其中蘊含的強大力量。^000000

scripts.text:
^4d4dffAll of a sudden, the Green Key appears and you can feel great power from it.^000000
^4d4dffWhen you pick up the key,
your body trembles
with an unknown power
and you see a hallucination with some text.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff突然，綠色鑰匙出現了，你能感受到其中蘊含的強大力量。^000000
^4d4dff當你拿起鑰匙時，
你的身體因一股未知的力量而顫抖，
你看到了帶有文字的幻象。^000000

scripts.text: Concentrate on it.
scripts.translation: 集中注意力。

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text:
^b22222...You found 4 keys
and finally released 4 spells...
This tower used to be
a gate to summon demons ages ago.
And the last visitor was
the infamous Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
^b22222...你找到了4把鑰匙，
並終於釋放了4個咒語...
這座塔曾經是
召喚惡魔的傳送門。
而最後的訪客是
臭名昭著的魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text:
^b22222As I followed her trail
I realized that her spells
were scattered around the tower.
Then, somehow, it vanished into the ground.
scripts.translation:
^b22222當我追蹤她的蹤跡時，
我發現她的咒語散落在塔中各處。
然後，不知為何，它消失在了地面之下。

scripts.text:
^b22222The great battle and
the protracted war...
But her purpose was...
that... sealing of the gate...
so... I tried to seal...
but it was incomplete...
the guard of the gate was...^000000
scripts.translation:
^b22222那場偉大的戰鬥
和漫長的戰爭...
但她的目的是...
那個...封印傳送門...
所以...我試圖封印...
但它並不完整...
傳送門的守衛是...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is hard to read.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
字跡難以辨認。

scripts.text:
^b22222...So I changed the location
of the coupling spot...
I mean, push through to the tower
to tangle it...
Anyway, I wanted to respect
her loyalty and block the gate...
scripts.translation:
^b22222...於是我改變了連線點的位置...
我的意思是，強行突破到塔中
將其糾纏在一起...
總之，我想尊重她的忠誠，
並封鎖傳送門...

scripts.text:
^b22222If I want to... then I have to
release the last spell...
He finally came to meet...
with his pieces...
...and then...^000000
scripts.translation:
^b22222如果我想...那麼我就必須
釋放最後一個咒語...
他終於帶著他的棋子
前來赴約了...
...然後...^000000

scripts.text:
The hallucination wobbles
and fades into the key.
scripts.translation: 幻覺搖曳不定，最終化作了鑰匙。

scripts.text: It was too intense to see the hallucination, so you gave up reading.
scripts.translation: 幻覺太過強烈，你無法看清，於是放棄了閱讀。

scripts.text: You decide to ignore it.
scripts.translation: 你決定無視它。

scripts.text: You don't have the right key for this keyhole.
scripts.translation: 你沒有適合這個鎖孔的鑰匙。

scripts.text: The spell is already released. You've acquired everything you need from this statue.
scripts.translation: 咒語已經釋放。你已從這尊雕像處獲得所需的一切。

scripts.text:
An old, worn sword hangs above the splendid table.
It emits a gloomy aura.
scripts.translation:
一把古老、磨損的劍懸掛在華麗的桌子上方。
它散發著陰森的氣息。

scripts.text:
As you approach, the keys in your pocket
suddenly respond with a mysterious power.
scripts.translation:
當你靠近時，口袋裡的鑰匙
突然響應著一種神秘的力量。

scripts.text: Observe it.
scripts.translation: 觀察它

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to leave
the sword alone.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你決定不去碰那把劍。^000000

scripts.text:
While you get closer and closer, the sword shakes with a loud noise.
Your eyes keep getting drawn to the sword's hilt.
Then you lose control of your hands, and they stretch forth to grasp the handle...
scripts.translation:
隨著你越來越近，劍發出巨大的聲響並劇烈震動。
你的目光不由自主地被劍柄吸引。
接著你失去了對手的控制，雙手不由自主地伸出去握住劍柄...

scripts.text: Towards the blade of the sword
scripts.translation: 伸向劍刃

scripts.text: Towards the hilt of the sword
scripts.translation: 伸向劍柄

scripts.text: Towards the table
scripts.translation: 伸向桌子

scripts.text:
By an unknown calling you decide to grab the blade of the sword.
Your hands get wounded and begin to bleed.
scripts.translation:
在某種未知的召喚下，你決定抓住劍刃。
你的手受傷了，開始流血。

scripts.text:
By an unknown calling you decide to grab the hilt of the sword.
The mysterious power from the keys transfers to the sword, and it falls from the table.
scripts.translation:
在某種未知的召喚下，你決定握住劍柄。
鑰匙中的神秘力量轉移到了劍上，劍從桌上掉落。

scripts.text:
At the same time, a little hole appears on the table's surface.
Now, you hold the sword and...
scripts.translation:
與此同時，桌面上出現了一個小孔。
現在，你握著劍，並且...

scripts.text: Strike the table
scripts.translation: 敲擊桌子

scripts.text: Insert the sword into the hole
scripts.translation: 將劍插入孔中

scripts.text: Bring the sword safely
scripts.translation: 安全地帶走劍

scripts.text:
You strike the table with the sword.
Numerous conflicting spells act upon it, and you can tell that you chose incorrectly.
The sword automatically returns to the table, as it was before.
scripts.translation:
你用劍敲擊了桌子。
無數相互衝突的魔法作用於其上，你意識到自己選錯了。
劍自動回到了桌上，恢復了原狀。

scripts.text:
As you insert the sword, lightning flashes around it and black smoke rises from the hole.
Slowly the smoke clears, and you see an object with a certain shape...
scripts.translation:
當你將劍插入孔中時，周圍閃過雷電，孔中升起黑煙。
煙霧漸漸散去，你看到一個具有特定形狀的物品...

scripts.text: ^4d4dff All of a sudden, a Black Key appears from the smoke and you feel a great cursed power from it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff突然，一把黑色鑰匙從煙霧中顯現，你從中感受到一股強大的詛咒之力。^000000

scripts.text:
A drawer had snapped open under the table while you picked up the key and observed it.
You can see an old notebook inside the drawer.
scripts.translation:
當你拿起鑰匙並觀察它時，桌子下方的一個抽屜突然彈開了。
你可以看到抽屜裡有一本舊筆記本。

scripts.text:
The notebook definitely looks like it contains an important message.
Maybe this notebook is the one that Rekenber wants to find, even with all the sacrifices.
scripts.translation:
這本筆記本看起來確實包含重要資訊。
也許這就是雷肯貝爾不惜一切代價也要尋找的那本筆記本。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffYou decide to show the notebook and the keys to Burled.
You received Varmunt's Journal.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff你決定將筆記本和鑰匙展示給伯爾德。
你獲得了瓦爾蒙特的日記。^000000

scripts.text:
When you lift the sword, you feel a shock from numerous conflicting spells.
Right... stealing is the worst.
The sword automatically returns to the table, as it was before.
scripts.translation:
當你舉起劍時，你感受到無數相互衝突的魔法帶來的衝擊。
沒錯...偷竊是最糟糕的行為。
劍自動回到了桌上，恢復了原狀。

scripts.text: You stretch your hands to find something under the table, but there is nothing.
scripts.translation: 你伸手去摸桌子下面，想找到什麼東西，但那裡什麼都沒有。

scripts.text:
You strongly feel a cursed, sealed power from here,
but it is hard to figure out what is causing it.
You cannot approach it.
scripts.translation:
你強烈地感覺到這裡有一股被封印的詛咒之力，
但很難弄清楚是什麼造成的。
你無法靠近它。

scripts.text:
You have already released a seal using this sword.
You've acquired everything you need from here.
scripts.translation:
你已經用這把劍解開了一個封印。
你在這裡已經獲得了所有需要的東西。

scripts.text: The Crystal ball is emitting mysterious power.
scripts.translation: 水晶球正散發著神秘的力量。

scripts.text:
Beside the crystal ball, you find faded patterns marked on the floor.
Looks like some kind of keyhole that needs to be inserted with something...
scripts.translation:
在水晶球旁邊，你發現地板上刻有褪色的圖案。
看起來像是某種需要插入某物的鑰匙孔...

scripts.text:
The red key suddenly responds once you come close to the keyhole.
You insert the key in the keyhole and it turns out to be a small gem.
scripts.translation:
當你靠近鑰匙孔時，紅色鑰匙突然有了反應。
你將鑰匙插入鑰匙孔，結果發現它其實是一顆小寶石。

scripts.text:
When you touch the gem which is dazzling red...
You feel isolated and depressed deep inside your heart...
scripts.translation:
當你觸控那顆耀眼的紅色寶石時...
你內心深處感到一種孤立無援和深深的壓抑...

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou have found a Red Charm Stone that is concentrated with cruel fate and a deep darkness.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你找到了一顆魔力紅寶石，其中凝聚著殘酷的命運和深沉的黑暗。^000000

scripts.text:
The Crystal ball is emitting mysterious power.
Something is definitely there inside... How do I get it to open?
scripts.translation:
水晶球正散發著神秘的力量。
裡面肯定有什麼東西...我該怎麼讓它開啟呢？

It's a statue giving off a golden light.
The sword appears to be missing a gem.
As I draw closer to the statue, the Yellow Charm Stone emits a bright light.
scripts.translation:
這是一座散發著金色光芒的雕像。
劍上似乎缺少了一顆寶石。
當你靠近雕像時，魔力黃寶石發出了明亮的光芒。

scripts.text: Insert the Yellow Charm Stone.
scripts.translation: 插入魔力黃寶石

scripts.text: Run away.
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text: After inserting the Yellow Charm Stone into the sword, the statue begins to react.
scripts.translation: 將魔力黃寶石插入劍中後，雕像開始有了反應。

scripts.text: Someone has already inserted a Charm Stone into this statue.
scripts.translation: 已經有人將魔力寶石插入這座雕像了。

scripts.text:
The statue give off mysterious light.
Strange power has blocked your access.
scripts.translation:
雕像散發著神秘的光芒。
一股奇異的力量阻擋了你的去路。

scripts.text: The statue has such a strong light that I can't see or touch it.
scripts.translation: 雕像的光芒太強了，我既看不見也摸不著它。

scripts.translation:
一座雕像散發著綠色光芒。

The shadow of a Black Key is gleaming in the center of the portal.
To pass this way, looks like I need something.

傳送門中央閃爍著黑色鑰匙的影子。

scripts.text:

The barricade is removed through the power from newly formed black magic gem.
